what: Mika the fox-girl flame swordswoman, a chibi fantasy RPG heroine: pointed orange fox ears with cream inner fur, long red-orange hair with a long braid swept back behind her, a red ribbon and a small gold flower ornament in her hair, amber eyes, a cream-white scarf whose ends blow back behind her, a ragged red shawl with ember-orange edges trailing behind her shoulders, black and red lacquered samurai light armour with gold trim and a gold shoulder guard, a red tabard with a gold crest, black armoured greaves with gold knee plates, ONE big fluffy orange fox tail with a cream-white tip behind her on the LEFT side of the image, a slim silver katana with a gold guard
pose: She stands in a springy, playful ready stance, knees slightly bent and feet apart, her katana held low in her right hand at her side with the blade angled down toward the ground in front of her, her left hand raised in front of her chest making a fox hand sign (middle and ring fingers touching the thumb, index and little finger raised like fox ears), a cheeky confident grin, her ONE big fox tail curled up high behind her on the left, the scarf ends and shawl blowing back.
idle: a springy, playful idle: her body, face, hands, katana and boots stay still; her ONE big fox tail stays behind her on the LEFT in every frame (it never crosses to the other side and never jumps) and swishes in a smooth S-curve, the white tip curling up a little more each frame (frames 1-4) and back down (frames 5-8), each frame only a small step from the one before, the tail never jumps up or grows; her braid, scarf ends and shawl tatters sway gently with the tail. Her head, face, eyes and BOTH fox ears stay exactly as in Image 1 in every frame: the ears never twitch, flatten, fold, tilt or change size.
entrance: her fox-fire summoning, everything drawn SMALL enough to stay well inside each cell: the flames never rise higher than the top of her ears in Image 1 and never spread wider than her tail and scarf. Frame 1: no character yet, only three small round orange fox-fire flames (kitsunebi) floating in a ring just above the ground where she will stand. Frame 2: the fox-fires circle and multiply into a ring of six small flames on the ground. Frame 3: the flames rush together and rise into a whirling flame pillar the same height as she is, its top shaped like a fox head with two pointed ears. Frame 4: the fox-shaped flame pillar, her dark silhouette visible inside it. Frame 5: she springs up out of the top of the flame pillar, katana in hand, her fox tail streaming, the pillar collapsing below her (her head still inside the cell). Frame 6: she lands in a low crouch, a few small flames flickering out around her boots. Frame 7: she rises from the crouch, the last small flames winking out. Frame 8: exactly the resting pose of Image 1, no flames. All flames are clean opaque painted shapes with crisp edges, never smoke, glow haze or loose sparks.
